reviews.text: Kind and knowledgeable staff

I have always found kindness, professionalism, and above all, a great deal of affection towards my little one... you can sense that for the Doctors this isn't just a job, but rather a mission, to be carried out with love and dedication.
I had a great experience, Dr. Troisi was kind and helpful as well as very knowledgeable!

We went to the clinic for an emergency and were greeted with EXTREMELY PROFESSIONAL and EMPATHY.
We were cared for by Dr. Marco and Dr. Troisi, two exemplary professionals who explained the entire situation to us in detail, yet with tact.
They care about animals, and to them and the entire staff, I extend my deepest THANK YOU.
There are clinics that do everything they can to make as much money as possible, while in this one, they do everything they can to ensure the animal's well-being.
THANK YOU.
I love you all.
Good and kind
We had a great experience with Dr. Cecchini, especially with our Maltese's dermatitis.

I went to this clinic for the first time with my 11-year-old dog, who has always been very difficult to manage at the vet, so much so that even a simple visit often required sedation. She had a perianal abscess, and since my regular vet wasn't available, I turned to them.
Dr. Tamara and nurse Erika were phenomenal; I'd never seen my dog ​​so calm during a veterinary visit.
I recommend them without a doubt💕
Dr. Chiocchi and his team are highly competent and dedicated professionals. I've been coming to this clinic for almost twenty years and highly recommend it.
I called for information about the kittens I adopted: the veterinary technician, Erika, was amazing, truly professional and knowledgeable. Always ask about her.

Good morning Simone, you're not listed in our management system. If you've used our services and encountered any issues, I'd be very grateful if you'd contact us to share your experience so we can improve our service.
Kind and professional🤗 …
Thank you!

I've known Dr. Chiocchi and Dr. Giorgi for several years. They are excellent doctors, highly trained, empathetic, and helpful. The entire staff is professional and always available. The office is large, clean, and welcoming. Highly recommended.

At this veterinary center, I appreciated the promptness and professionalism. I saw that the doctors work with expertise and love for animals. Since it's not a large center, you can talk and be listened to. The prices are fair. Laura.
Very kind, very good. We had a great time. Thanks to everyone, especially Dr. Marco Chiocchi.
Hi Valerio, thanks for your review.
Kindness, competence and professionalism.
Really positive experience

My Maltese Luna has been treated at this clinic for many years. The care, professionalism, and kindness of the staff have always been top priority. She has always been treated by Dr. Renzi, who, for specific situations, has even referred us to specialists who have confirmed her diagnoses. We recommend her without hesitation, and we will continue to entrust our dog to them.
I had an emergency with my cat. Even though I'm not their client, they checked him out and examined him very carefully. Kind and professional.
Thank you! Martina
Thanks Cesidio!
I've been seeing Dr. Chiocchi and his team for years. They're very professional and knowledgeable. The reception staff is also kind and courteous.

Barbara, Andrea, and the entire staff, always attentive to the patient, follow us every step of the way: always available, attentive, and professional. On behalf of Teddy and myself, thank you from the bottom of my heart and Happy New Year! See you at your next routine checkups!
Professionalism and great love for animals highly recommended
Thank you :-)
Thanks Ewald!
Thanks Sonia! :-)

We met the vet through a friend. We had a great experience. They took great care of our cat and made her well in just a few days. The staff was very professional, from the front desk to the medical team, who were truly kind and honest.
I've been waiting for an hour and I went in urgently but it feels like I'm at Gemelli (you could die)
We have been loyal patients of Dr. Chiocchi for about 30 years, and, over time, of other exceptional veterinarians. They are empathetic and expert professionals.
Thank you!
We get along very well with our kitten 🐈 …

I didn't feel at all comfortable, I was out of the region, my dog ​​had diarrhea and vomiting, I would have waited until last, they told me no and gave me an address that I would have to reach by taxi, no, that's not how it works😔 …

Today we took our 11-year-old cat there and received excellent service! From the moment we arrived until we were seen by Dr. Flavia, everyone was extremely attentive and kind! Dr. Flavia was truly very efficient and demonstrated, in addition to great affection for our cat, great professionalism and competence! We highly recommend the veterinary clinic!

I've been going to this practice for years and have always been very satisfied. The vets are competent, helpful, and attentive to the animals' well-being. The environment is clean and welcoming. Highly recommended!
Thank you!
Specialized and clean veterinary clinic. My daughter took our dog for surgery and was very impressed with the helpfulness of the staff. Maybe they could lower the prices a little. Thanks.
THANK YOU ALESSANDRA!!!
Thank you, Rossano, for choosing us and placing your trust in us by entrusting us with a member of your family!

After 15 years, my beloved dog left me
...and a few days ago, Joy entered my life, and honestly, I found myself having to change vets for various reasons... thus, taking her to the Boccea Clinic, I didn't expect to find such empathy, kindness, and availability. Dr. Troisi examined us, and honestly, I can't find the words to describe her. Her sweetness moved me, and given my very special moment, I really appreciated it. I might add, after two thorough visits to the little pest, this morning she called me to change a medication because in the meantime she had been thinking about various situations that could arise during the summer.
I would like to thank the doctor and also those who answer the calls, who are very attentive to their needs, schedules, etc. Thank you again, and we'll see each other for many more years to come. Thank you from Letizia, Joy, and Grandma Angela 🐾🐾

I had a wonderful experience, the staff were attentive and thorough. I had my Persian cat examined by Dr. Renzi for an ear problem, and it was a very thorough examination. She's doing great now. Thank you, doctor, for your courtesy, kindness, and compassion. Thank you again.

Welcoming environment, qualified and professional doctors.
Expertise, reliability, and skill. Excellent clinic.

Kindness, courtesy, and professionalism. We always feel valued, and every detail is crucial in the diagnosis. Thank you for the attention you give to our four-legged friend and to the person. Thank you!

I've known the clinic's veterinarians for many years and am so happy to have met them! They are competent, empathetic, and helpful; we trust them with complete peace of mind. Our dog is calm and happy when we go for checkups. Highly recommended.
Kind and friendly...
Thank you!

Always very helpful and professional. They interact with our pets with such sweetness, trying to make them feel at ease. They're also always polite and available to explain and advise us owners. I highly recommend them.

I've always had a great experience. The staff are well-trained professionals who, above all, know how to listen, something that can never be taken for granted these days. I've been walking my dog ​​for many years and will continue to do so with the utmost trust. I recommend this facility without a doubt.
Everyone was great and helpful, recommended!'

I've known the Boccea Veterinary Clinic for 12 years, since my dog, Argo, was a puppy. Dr. Germana and Dr. Andrea have cared for him ever since with a unique combination of professionalism, empathy, and kindness. They treat each animal as if they were part of their family, and this is immediately apparent, from the first meeting.

My dog ​​has suffered from an intestinal condition since he was a puppy, but thanks to their expertise and dedication, he has always managed to live a peaceful and uncomplicated life.
I trust them with my eyes closed: they are extraordinary doctors, with profound knowledge and a genuine love for animals.
Highly recommended. I could never entrust Argo to anyone else.

I made an appointment for my almost 1-year-old pitbull. The girl on the phone was already annoyed, so I don't know where the friendliness was.
The day of the appointment arrived, chaos, missed the scheduled time, moved from one room to another without even knowing what to do.
During the visit, not understanding the problem, the doctor judged (without knowing) my husband and the dog, still not performing the examination or offering any solutions. Having paid for the visit with less clarity than before, I had to go to another vet, who solved the problem immediately and provided the correct treatment. Terrible experience. I don't recommend it, both for the prices and the staff!
Thank you! :-)
I have been taking my dog ​​for several years and I really enjoy the professionalism and human relationship with the love for animals.
Thank you :-)

Good morning, Mr. Comparato,
Thank you for your review. Unfortunately, I can't find it in our database, which prevents me from contacting you for more detailed feedback on your experience here. If you would be so kind as to contact us, I would be happy to receive more information about your experience at our facility so we can further improve our service.
Best regards,
Dr. Germana Giorgi

Exceptional, professional people, very sweet with animals and kind to their owners. I've finally found capable vets who know what they're talking about thanks to their experience and training. I recommend them to everyone.
Very good vets
Professionalism, kindness, and expertise. A heartfelt thank you to all the staff.

Serious, knowledgeable, honest, empathetic, and incredibly kind professionals. I met them three years ago through a friend, and I've never left them. I had a small, abandoned, and battered kitten off the street. He had intestinal parasites, worms, giardia, and much more, and in a week they completely cured him! Now that the cat is older, although he's still very fearful, when we go to see them, he's still calm and willing to be treated because they're so good, calm, and you can really feel their love for animals. 💓
Excellent clinic, kind and competent staff, everyone, in particular Dr. Renzi who treated my cat with kindness and professionalism.

I wanted to share my highly positive experience. I had a checkup, two vaccines, and fecal tests. I must confirm a thorough examination, from a simple temperature to objective tests on my Molly! I'm now returning for a vaccine and a checkup... I asked for my puppy to be treated by the same doctor, and my request was granted.
Empathy, love for animals, and great professionalism, despite the distance from my home, I will gladly go because I found what I was looking for!!!
10 stars!
Thank you!

What can I say? I called for an appointment. My little basset wasn't feeling well. The appointment was less than an hour later. The exam was done as expected, with plenty of explanations and, above all, reassurance. I went back the next day and had another examination... What can I say? The doctors and medical staff were fantastic! Thanks everyone!

As someone has already said, this clinic's interest lies not in the patient.

Since it's not possible to reply to the response, I've edited and added details to my review, always referring to the response I received from the doctor. I've received no form of availability, so I don't understand what you're referring to, as every single visit and checkup was paid in full and without any request, on the same day as the tests, visits, ultrasound, EKG, and everything else. Precisely because of the enormous expense incurred in such a short time and paid at every single visit, I had requested installment plans (not for an indefinite period) but over two months, for the operation alone. This was denied, with the proposal being, at most, to split the amount into two installments, one seven days apart.
What would this availability be?
I was contacted not to answer the question of deferral, but to find out if I could afford the cost of the operation and that, in that case, I would have to vacate the operating room. If that's what being available means to you.
The clinic doesn't thrive on love alone, and I've noticed this since everything, from everyone's side, is paid at the same time as the patient's visit.
Have a good evening.
I asked them politely and explained my work situation. The secretary showed no empathy whatsoever. I regret having to take my cat there for a year!!!
Thank you!
Thanks, Claudia! :-)
Professionalism, reliability, and kindness. I also appreciated the short wait times and the outdoor space, which made it easier to wait for my dog's appointment.

Thanks, Martina!
:-)
Very kind and helpful.
wonderful on a human and professional level.
Thanks, Elena!
Thanks Donato!

We took our cat for a visit and spent €180 for the exam and tests. However, the cat's condition worsened following the prescribed treatment. We therefore needed another medication, which, however, cannot be purchased without a prescription. At that point, we called the clinic while we were at the pharmacy to get the prescription, but it never arrived because they wanted to re-examine the cat even though they had the card and all the tests; it was Friday evening and they were about to close. At that point, we went to a veterinarian near the pharmacy. We explained the situation to him, and he immediately wrote us the prescription and refused to even accept payment. Obviously, we will never return to the Boccea Veterinary Clinic: we believe they care more about the fees than the animals.
The cat is fine now.
Thanks Umberto!
Thanks for the review and a big thumbs up to Oliver! :-)
